text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down more than 3% in the past day, with Ethereum underperforming slightly, suggesting modest risk-off conditions across the majors. The Fear & Greed Index at 29 reflects genuine fear sentiment, though the 4-point weekly rise hints at some stabilization rather than accelerating panic. Bitcoin's dominance holding above 56% and $69B in daily volume indicate the market is functioning normally despite the retreat, without signs of forced liquidations or extreme distress.
